# zlib compression sources

Compression-only subset of zlib 1.3.2, unmodified, from
https://zlib.net/zlib-1.3.2.tar.gz.
Archive SHA-256: `bb329a0a2cd0274d05519d61c667c062e06990d72e125ee2dfa8de64f0119d16`.
The accompanying zlib license applies. These sources compress Kitty RGB frames;
vendoring them keeps the static engine build independent of system zlib packages.
